caption: The drawing features a rectangular composition with a decorative border colored in gray with small white ovals near the top and bottom edges. The main background is a deep red. In the upper section, there are three human figures and one animal. On the left, there is a black horse with a person dressed in yellow pants and a red top seated sideways on its back. In the center, there is a woman in a white top and a voluminous, blue-gray skirt, standing with one hand on her waist. To the right, another woman is depicted in a yellow dress with red accents and a flared skirt, posed with one arm behind her. Around and beside the figures are stylized flowers: blue circular flowers on both the left and right sides, as well as large flower shapes with concentric petals, and green leafy accents. In the lower decorative horizontal panel, there are large stylized flowers in gray, white, blue, pink, and yellow with green leaves, all set against the same red background. Grass-like green patches appear below the figures, with pink, green, and white highlighting flowing through the design.
title: Plate 42: Painted Chest Design: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
